program_hint: Agrivoltaics research partnerships (University of Arizona Casa Grande site, solar grazing)
why: AES hosts the University of Arizona agrivoltaics plots at its Casa Grande, Arizona solar plant and says it contributes to agrivoltaics research with universities; no published fund, so the ask is sponsored research or site access.

program_hint: Regenerative Energy and Agrivoltaics (CattleTracker study with academia)
why: Solar developer that runs agrivoltaics on more than 20 sites and a cross-industry cattle-and-solar study with academic experts; a field-site and co-research partner, amounts unpublished.

program_hint: Agrivoltaics research with agricultural and academic partners
why: Global solar developer whose agrivoltaics programme says it works with local and academic partners across the Americas; no published grant, so SALSAV would pitch a joint trial.

program_hint: Agrivoltaics and land stewardship research gifts
why: Self-described top US agrivoltaics developer that gave Colorado State a USD 60,000 dryland research gift; a partner for field sites, but single gifts so far look well under USD 200,000.

program_hint: University research program with ASU, NAU and the University of Arizona
why: Arizona utility that funds about USD 3 million a year across 34 to 37 university projects on power, water and sustainability; no public call found and awards look small, so SALSAV should ask SRP about a water-energy project.

program_hint: Water restoration projects in Arizona (Colorado River basin)
why: Intel has funded 20 Arizona water projects, mostly irrigation efficiency and crop conversion run by conservation nonprofits and farmers; a university would partner through those groups to add measurement.

program_hint: Freeport in My Community funding opportunities (Arizona)
why: Arizona mining company that funds education, workforce, water, land and food security work and has given the University of Arizona multi-million awards; mostly mining education, so SALSAV would pitch workforce or community resilience.

org: The Mosaic Company Foundation for Sustainable Food Systems
program_hint: Soil health, water quality and community development grants
why: Funds sustainable agriculture, soil and water work in the US, Brazil and India through an annual application with published guidelines; check whether universities can apply.

program_hint: Environmental sustainability, Land and Water (regenerative agriculture, water stewardship)
why: Funds sustainable farming and water use by invitation only, with occasional open requests for proposals; a relationship-building target, not an open call.

program_hint: Backing farmers and safe water access
why: Funds smallholder farming, water access and workforce programmes with local partners worldwide; no public application path found, so this is a cultivate lead.

program_hint: Environmental Resilience programme (Chile, Peru and global)
why: Mining foundation that funds land, biodiversity and water resilience in Chile and Peru and has funded universities, but its programmes look invitation-only and conservation-focused.

program_hint: Water stewardship and community water grants
why: Funds watershed protection and water access worldwide and has made a few USD 500,000 university awards; the application route and agriculture fit still need checking.

program_hint: Carbon Removal and Superpollutant Abatement R&D Awards (agriculture and biomass)
why: Unrestricted gifts of up to USD 500,000 to universities for climate R&D including agricultural residues; the 2026 round closed 25 September 2026, so watch for a 2027 round.

program_hint: Impact Challenge: AI for Science (climate resilience track)
why: USD 36 million open call for researchers, including a climate resilience and environmental science track with grants of roughly USD 500,000 to 3 million; the 2026 round is closed, so watch for a repeat and an AI-for-agrivoltaics angle.
